derived_by: index census: every key of model.layers.78 (the MTP block transformers never builds); this artifact quantizes the MTP block's routed experts too, so the census is the 23 non-expert names of the bf16 allowlist plus 12288 rank-sharded payload objects (768 expert modules x 4 ranks x 4 objects)
relation_to_bf16_allowlist: the 23 plain names are exactly the non-expert names of engines/tools/layer-outer-evidence/glm53-layer78-unexpected-keys.json, and the 768 composed payload modules are exactly its 768 expert weights; the streamed loader reports over-index keys from the index, so the set is the raw index census
